days.name: Mahalaya
days.description: Marks the auspicious beginning of Devi Paksha and Goddess Durga's arrival journey to Earth.

days.name: Maha Panchami
days.description: Welcoming of Goddess Durga with evening mandap inaugurations and preliminary Kalparambha rituals across Kolkata.

days.name: Maha Shashthi
days.description: The Goddess's idol is unveiled to the public for the first time amidst Dhak beats and Bodhon rituals.

days.name: Maha Saptami
days.description: Nine sacred plants symbolizing Durga's nine forms are bathed at dawn in the Hooghly river and installed.

days.name: Maha Ashtami
days.description: The most sacred day of Durga Puja; Sandhi Puja marks the precise junction between Ashtami and Navami when Mahishasuramardini slays Chanda and Munda.

days.name: Maha Navami
days.description: Final day of grand battle between Durga and Mahishasura, celebrated with holy Havans and evening Dhunuchi Naach.

days.name: Vijaya Dashami
days.description: Durga Visarjan — ceremonial immersion of idols in the Hooghly river, marking Goddess Durga's return to Kailash.
